description: 283-line OnPush order dashboard with three injectable services; every subscription uses takeUntilDestroyed or the async pipe except one: ngOnInit subscribes to the root-provided AlertFeed.unreadCount$ with no teardown, leaking a subscription per component instance

hard.note: The one subscription leak is a single line among several correctly torn-down subscriptions in a 283-line file

_calibration.note: Window modeled on the framework's existing *-reactivity-issues fixture (one error per planted defect), narrowed to the single planted defect plus room for one incidental warning or suggestion.
